# qpdf (WebAssembly build)

* `qpdf.js` and `qpdf.wasm` are the unmodified build from `@neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm@0.3.0`
  (ISC licence), which compiles **qpdf** (Apache License 2.0) to WebAssembly.
* qpdf: Copyright (c) 2005-2024 Jay Berkenbilt and contributors — Apache-2.0.
* WASM build: Copyright (c) 2021 neslinesli93 — ISC.

Full licence texts:
* Apache-2.0 — https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
* qpdf source — https://github.com/qpdf/qpdf
* WASM wrapper — https://github.com/neslinesli93/qpdf-wasm

Used by Luma PDF for AES-256 password protection and unlocking, entirely inside the
browser tab.
